results.name: Cable Alternate Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with your back facing the low pulley, holding the handle behind your head with your arm bent, elbow pointing up and palm facing the ceiling. Use your other hand to support the active arm by holding it just above the elbow.
Extend your active arm up overhead, straightening your elbow to push the handle upward.
Slowly return your arm to the starting position behind your head. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your upper arm stationary throughout the exercise to isolate the triceps.
Avoid using momentum; perform the movement slowly and with control.
Exhale as you extend your arm and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Alternate Triceps Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Cable Cross Pushdown
instructions: Stand upright between two high cable pulleys and hold each handle in the opposite hand.Bend your elbows so that the handles are crossing in front of your chest.
Extend your elbows to press the handles down and outward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly while squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly bend your elbows to return the handles to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your sides throughout the exercise.
Move only at your elbows and avoid swinging your shoulders.
Keep your torso upright and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you press the handles downward.
results.description: Cable Cross Pushdown is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Core.

results.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension (Low)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley of a cable machine. Lie on a flat bench with your head positioned near the pulley. Grasp the bar or rope with an overhand grip, your arms extended straight up above your chest.
Lower the bar towards your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Just before touching your forehead, extend your arms back to the starting position, focusing on contracting your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms to isolate the triceps.
Focus on the contraction of your triceps as you extend your arms.
Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you lower the bar.
results.description: Cable Lying Triceps Extension (Low) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the middle pulley of a cable machine. Lie on a flat bench with your head positioned near the pulley. Grasp the bar or rope with an overhand grip, your arms extended straight up above your chest.
Lower the bar towards your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Just before touching your forehead, extend your arms back to the starting position, focusing on contracting your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms to isolate the triceps.
Focus on the contraction of your triceps as you extend your arms.
Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you lower the bar.
results.description: Cable Lying Triceps Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Neutral Grip Kickback
instructions: Attach a handle to a middle pulley on a cable machine. Stand facing the machine and grasp the handle with your left hand, using a neutral grip (palm facing your body). Step back to create tension in the cable.

Position your feet shoulder-width apart and bend slightly at the hips, keeping your back straight and core engaged. Your upper arm should be parallel to the floor and close to your body with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your left arm straight back by straightening your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary and focusing on contracting your triceps.
Slowly return your arm to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your right hand.
tips: Keep your upper arm stationary and only move your forearm to isolate the triceps.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce the risk of injury.
Exhale as you extend your arm and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Neutral Grip Kickback is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Overhead Extension Rope
instructions: Attach a rope handle to the high pulley on a cable machine. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, back to the machine, and grasp the rope handle with both hands, palms facing each other.
Step forward to create tension in the cable. Extend your arms straight in level with your torso, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you lower the rope.
results.description: Cable Overhead Extension Rope is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Cable Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Grasp the bar with both hands, palms facing down, and place your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and lean slightly forward, keeping your back straight and elbows close to your body. Your forearms should be parallel to the floor.
Push the bar down towards your thighs by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you push the bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees for better stability.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
results.description: Cable Pushdown is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Cable Rear Drive
instructions: Stand straight with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine. Set the pulley at shoulder height and grasp the handle of the cable with your right hand, palm facing down. Set your arm parallel to the floor in front of you and bent at 90 degrees.
Drive your elbow sideways while slowly straightening your arm, pulling the cable across your chest.
Slowly bring your arm back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left hand.
tips: Focus on squeezing your upper back muscles at the top of the movement.
Maintain a neutral wrist position to prevent strain.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees for better stability.
results.description: Cable Rear Drive is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (Side View)
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Grasp the bar with both hands using an underhand grip (palms facing up), hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and elbows close to your body. Your forearms should be parallel to the floor.
Push the bar down towards your thighs by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, allowing your forearms to become parallel to the floor again. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid moving your upper arms.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you push the bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (Side View) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Shoulders.

results.name: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Push Down Straight Bar on Crossover
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Grasp the bar with both hands using an underhand grip (palms facing up), hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and elbows close to your body. Your forearms should be parallel to the floor.
Push the bar down towards your thighs by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, allowing your forearms to become parallel to the floor again. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid moving your upper arms.
Focus on squeezing your triceps at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you push the bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Push Down Straight Bar on Crossover is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Shoulders.
